sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Type checker rules
sections.what: Sets the type checker's rules: language version, module style, React markup support, which checks are on or off, and which folder to check.
sections.why: The file notes that the checks were relaxed for initial development.
sections.watch_out: With strict checks off, real mistakes can reach the app without warnings.

summary: Sets the rules the TypeScript checker follows for the frontend, with many strictness checks turned off.
purpose: Tells the type checker which language version, module style, and files to check.
why: The file says it is relaxed for initial development, so loose checks were chosen to move quickly.
how: It targets modern JavaScript, uses bundler-style module lookup, does not write output files, enables React's markup syntax, turns off strict mode and most implicit-type and unused-code checks, and checks only the src folder.
outputs: Type errors reported during checks. No files are produced.
risks: Loose settings let many type mistakes through, including values that have no type and empty values that are not checked.
debug: If the editor shows odd type errors, check this file. Run the build check command to see the same errors in the terminal.
